name: ArtSpace
tagline: Vector illustration from one C# engine, on desktop and in the browser
summary: ArtSpace is a local-first vector illustration editor built with Uno Platform and SkiaSharp, with an Illustrator-style dark workspace. The document model, transaction engine, geometry, custom controls and workbench are shared C# running natively and on real Uno WebAssembly, with JavaScript confined to file transfer, recovery and input adaptation. It ships as nine reusable .NET libraries, six of which do not depend on Uno.

highlights.title: Pen, pencil and brush
highlights.text: Draw primitives, cubic pen paths, freehand pencil strokes, fixed-width brush strokes, text, artboards and slices.

highlights.title: Direct contour editing
highlights.text: Edit anchors on native, imported SVG, compound, expanded and glyph paths with exact cubic insertion, reconnecting removal and segment cutting.

highlights.title: Pathfinder and compounds
highlights.text: Boolean union, subtract, intersect and exclude, plus compound paths with nonzero or even-odd fill rules.

highlights.title: Editable opacity masks
highlights.text: Create, invert, disable and release alpha or luminance masks while keeping the mask source fully editable, including nested masks.

highlights.title: Gradients and appearance
highlights.text: Multiple fills and strokes, linear and radial gradients with stop opacity, blends, shadows and on-canvas gradient editing.

highlights.title: Text to outlines
highlights.text: Create Outlines converts text into editable glyph contours using the same glyph runs used for painting.

highlights.title: SVG and PNG interchange
highlights.text: Save native .artspace JSON, import and export a supported SVG subset, and export PNG pixels.

highlights.title: Local-first recovery
highlights.text: Autosave writes to IndexedDB in the browser or local app data on desktop; nothing is uploaded to a service.

items: Rectangles, ellipses, lines and cubic pen paths
Freehand pencil and fixed-width paintbrush strokes
Text with basic wrapping, tracking and alignment
Multiple frame-based artboards and slices
Selection, marquee, move, resize, rotate and flip
Duplication, grouping, stacking order, alignment and distribution
Clipboard and transactional undo/redo
Linked local symbols/components and bounded editable blends/repeats
Multi-anchor selection, marquee, drag and nudge
Exact cubic anchor insertion and reconnecting removal
Segment cutting and smooth/corner conversion with the Anchor Point tool
Make and release compound paths with nonzero/even-odd rules
Shape and stroke expansion
Positive and negative path offsets
Boolean union, subtract, intersect and exclude
Retained affine skew and nested group scaling
Multiple fills and strokes per object
Linear and radial gradients with stop opacity, focus, radius and spread
Opacity, blend modes and shadows
Editable vector clipping and alpha/luminance opacity masks
Native versioned JSON (.artspace, schema 3; reads schemas 1–3)
Supported SVG subset import and export, including gradients and masks
PNG raster export
IndexedDB (browser) and native local recovery
Retained geometry, text and gradient shader caches
Indexed stationary-target snapping
Conservative nested-leaf culling
Visible-panel-only refreshes and retained inspector sections

codeSamples.title: Embed the workbench
Build and run on desktop
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ArtSpace.git
cd ArtSpace
python3 scripts/fetch-assets.py

dotnet run --project tests/ArtSpace.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project src/ArtSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop \
  -p:ArtSpaceDesktopOnly=true

codeSamples.title: Publish the browser app
codeSamples.code:
dotnet workload install wasm-tools --skip-manifest-update
dotnet publish src/ArtSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/ArtSpace/
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish artifacts/site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py --directory artifacts/site

playground.intro: The live browser build opens the editable Alpine Echoes illustration across three artboards, running the same C# engine as desktop.

tour.title: Explore the sample
tour.text: Use the Artboards panel to select and fit the poster, badge and curve/color study, and the Layers panel to inspect individual objects.

tour.title: Draw a pen path
tour.text: Press P, click to place anchors, drag to set tangents, then press Enter to finish or click the first anchor to close.

tour.title: Edit anchors directly
tour.text: Select a shape and press A, then marquee or Shift-click anchors and drag or nudge them with the arrow keys.

tour.title: Combine shapes
tour.text: Select overlapping shapes and use Pathfinder to union, subtract, intersect or exclude them.

tour.title: Outline some text
tour.text: Press T to add text, then Ctrl Shift O to convert it into editable glyph contours.

tour.title: Save and export
tour.text: Use Save a Copy to download an editable .artspace file, or export SVG or PNG.

architecture.name: Model and formats
architecture.text: Platform-independent document, geometry and editable contours, plus validated native JSON schemas and the SVG subset.

architecture.name: Engine
architecture.text: Constraints and snapping, transactional editing with undo, and reusable illustration commands, all without Uno.

architecture.name: Rendering
architecture.text: SkiaSharp painting with retained caches, compositing, culling, hit testing and raster export.

architecture.name: Uno UI
architecture.text: Custom controls and an embeddable SKCanvasElement drawing surface with direct-manipulation gestures.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: The full application workspace, which a thin host app supplies with storage, fonts and lifetime.

boundaries: Functional alpha, not complete or pixel-identical Adobe Illustrator parity
No AI/EPS/PDF interchange; SVG support is a documented subset, not lossless roundtripping
No CMYK/ICC/spot color, gradient meshes, image tracing or pressure/pattern brushes
One active document session; direct contour editing works on one object at a time
Autosave is local recovery, not durable backup; browser storage can be cleared or evicted
